bepara.description: GST-compliant billing, inventory, and e-way bill management for Indian businesses. Built with Next.js + Supabase + Cloudflare Pages.

darpan.description: AI-powered social media audit and growth strategy tool. Profile analysis, AI content plans, brand kits, and competitor tracking — built with React + Vite frontend and Cloudflare Workers + D1 backend.

indra.description: High-performance automation backbone for the ecosystem. Powered by n8n, orchestrates complex multi-service workflows, webhook triggers, and real-time state sync across all business units.

kanak.description: Jewellery retail management SaaS. Real-time dashboard for inventory, gold rate tracking, sales, customer ledger, billing, and financial settlement.

karma.description: Production-ready MVP for a distributed compute marketplace. Users contribute compute resources and earn rewards. Track tasks, nodes, and earnings via a FastAPI agent runtime.

kubera.description: Personal finance OS — self-hosted, open-source tool for tracking wealth, investments, and financial goals. From debt to zero to wealth.

sri.description: Open-source design toolkit and the alternative to Claude Design. Local-first, web-deployable — 16 coding-agent CLIs, 31 composable Skills, 72 brand-grade Design Systems. Built with Next.js + TypeScript.

vishwakarma.description: One-click cloud provisioning portal. Guided form workflow for requesting cloud resources while the backend handles Terraform and OCI orchestration automatically.
